items.title: Euronews: Hungary and Ukraine edge towards deal that could unlock EU talks
items.content_text: Kyiv will propose a new law on minority education rights, with a vote expected in October. Budapest has blocked EU accession talks until Ukraine adopts the laws agreed under an 11-point plan on Hungarians in Transcarpathia.
